message.title: General Oceans ASA - Invitation to presentation of Q3 2026 results
message.body:
General Oceans ASA ("General Oceans" or the "Company") invites investors, analysts, media and other stakeholders to attend the presentation of its results for the third quarter of 2026. The Q3 report and presentation materials will be available on the Company's website www.generaloceans.com and on www.newsweb.no. The presentation will take place on 12 November 2026 at 08:00 CET at the Hotel Continental in Oslo, " Salen" and will also be live streamed. The presentation will be delivered by General Oceans President Atle Lohrmann and CFO Anton Van Heerden, and will be followed by a Q&A session. 

Questions may be submitted in advance to investors@generaloceans.com or asked live during the session. To attend in person or to watch the live stream, please register via the following link: https://qcnl.tv/p/58tsIWdtDNaXlXxaAk7miQ 

A recording of the presentation and the Q&A session will be published on the Company's website. For further information, please contact: Anton Van Heerden, CFO at General Oceans via investors@generaloceans.com.
